meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'лночь'). Common feminine noun meaning 'half the night' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I spent half the night on this.

examples.text: На кухне ресторана всегда есть полночь.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'тратить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'spent', paired with 'тратить'.

examples.trans: I spent half the night on this.

examples.text: Я потратила на дорогу два часа!
